title: Kth Smallest Element in BST - Solution
approach: Iterative in-order traversal tracking nodes count.
intuition: Given the root of a binary search tree, and an integer k, return the kth smallest value (1-indexed) of all the values of the nodes in the tree.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Iterative in-order traversal tracking nodes count.
common_mistakes: In-order traversal of a BST yields sorted elements. Stop traversal when kth element is reached.
